headings.usage: All page titles, card headers, and metric values. Use uppercase for labels.

body.usage: Paragraphs, table data, inputs, and small labels.

primary.name: Business Red
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, critical alerts, progress bars.

layout.spacing: Compact but breathable. Use p-6 for cards, gap-4 for grids.
layout.radius: rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (4px). Avoid large rounded corners.
layout.sidebar: Fixed left, w-64, dark zinc-900 background with red active indicators.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-sm). Uppercase text for primary actions.

cards.style: Flat background (zinc-900), 1px border (zinc-800). No shadow in dark mode.

tables.style: Dense. Header: uppercase, text-xs, text-zinc-500. Rows: hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors.

motion.micro_interactions: Fast (150ms). Buttons scale down slightly on click (0.98).

images.description: Modern corporate office with black/red accents. Use with a heavy black gradient overlay for text readability.
Close up of signing documents. Use for the 'Minutas' section header or empty state.
Digital padlock. Use for the 'Certificados Digitais' section.

login.layout: Split Screen. Left: Form (30%), Right: Image (70%).

dashboard.layout: Bento Grid. Top row: Key Metrics (Certificates Expiring, Pending Minutes). Middle: Recent Activity List. Right: Quick Actions.

minutas.layout: Two Column. Left: Upload & Chat (Interaction). Right: Preview/History.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Barlow Condensed' font for all headings immediately.
Force Dark Mode by adding 'dark' class to the html/body tag or using a ThemeProvider.
Use the specific hex codes provided for the 'Business Red' (#DC2626) - do not use default Tailwind red.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid #09090B.
For the 'Minutas' chat, make the user bubbles Red (#DC2626) and AI bubbles Zinc-800.
